copy.curiosityHook: With Fantasia crumbling under Xayide's dark influence, Bastian and Atreyu must confront the returning Emptiness before the world disappears entirely.
copy.description: Transported back to the magical realm of Fantasia, young Bastian discovers the world he once rescued faces a new threat: the evil sorceress Xayide and a creeping Emptiness that forces him to reunite with the warrior Atreyu.
copy.vibeSummary: Exciting and familiar family fantasy with a steady pace and moderate peril, offering an engaging yet easy-watch quest.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by George T. Miller, this brisk 90-minute fantasy adventure delivers an exciting, nostalgic return to a beloved storybook realm with clear stakes for family viewing.

allowedMaterial: The threat of the evil sorceress Xayide
excludedMaterial: Resolution of the battle with Xayide
The fate of Fantasia or the characters
